about.title: A production house for companies that put on a night for their people.
about.lead: EVENTS ON plans, designs, and delivers corporate events: annual nights, team days, kickoffs, and awards.
about.body: You don't need a spectacle site. You need a partner who can take an employee event from first conversation to the last person out.
about.body2: We work in Arabic and English on the same night when the room needs both. Direct, practical, without extra noise.
about.discoverBody: We sit with the brief, the employees, and the actual hall. Real floor, real timetable, and the feeling the night should leave.
about.designBody: Space, graphics, and AV in one conversation. What people see, hear, and walk through.
about.produceBody: Fabrication, install, show calling, and strike. The work employees never see is what makes the night look easy.

services.title: From a team day to a full stage.
services.lead: Production, AV, hospitality, and logistics — one team, so the night doesn't become a chain of handoffs.
